title: PartialCloseRequest
description: Update payload for PositionWorkflow.partial_close — the operator-initiated partial exit ('Trim') from the dashboard /live holdings table. Validator checks operator_id and reason are non-empty and that fraction is in (0,1) EXCLUSIVE: a trim is reduce-only by construction, so a full close must go through force_close instead. The handler enqueues a synthetic PartialExitRequest (market=true) onto the SAME pendingExits deque the STC path uses, so the trim inherits every existing partial-exit safeguard (qty ceil against live remainingQty, min-partial-qty behavior, dedupe, fill booking into realized P&L). WaitPolicy=Accepted: HTTP 202 returns immediately with the new exit_signal_id.

reason.description: Free-form operator-supplied reason recorded on the OperatorTrimRequested audit event.

fraction.description: Fraction of the remaining qty to sell. The workflow closes min(remainingQty, ceil(remainingQty * fraction)) contracts, matching the STC partial math exactly. Strictly < 1 so a trim can never be a full close.
